## 🚀 We're looking for contributors!

Hi everyone! 👋  

I'm **Arif Alam** — AI Engineer at EY, MBA candidate at NMIMS, and educator with 1M+ followers in the AI/Data Science community.

I just released **v1.0.0 of the `agentic-routing-framework`** — an open-source Python library for multi-agent LLM routing with safety guardrails and RAG context evaluation.

---

## 🤝 How You Can Contribute (All levels welcome!)

We have tasks for **everyone** — from fixing typos to implementing new model adapters:

📄 **[See all Good First Issues →](../GOOD_FIRST_ISSUES.md)**

| Level | Task | Time |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 🟢 Beginner | Fix README typos | 15 min |
| 🟢 Beginner | Add a usage code example to docs | 20 min |
| 🟡 Intermediate | Add a new unit test | 30 min |
| 🟡 Intermediate | Add new routing keywords | 30 min |
| 🔴 Advanced | Build OpenAI GPT-4o adapter | 1–2 hrs |

---

## 🛠️ Setup in 2 Commands
```bash
git clone https://github.com/iamarifalam/iamarifalam.git && cd iamarifalam
make dev && make test
```

All 8 tests should pass. If they don't, open an issue! 🙏
